summary.text: Gene Wu is a Democratic state representative and attorney who has represented Texas House District 137 since 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously worked as a felony prosecutor in the Harris County District Attorney's Office.

paragraphs.text: Gene Wu earned a high school diploma from St. Thomas Episcopal School, a bachelor's degree from Texas A&M University in 2000, a graduate degree from the University of Texas at Austin's LBJ School of Public Affairs in 2004, and a law degree from South Texas College of Law in 2008.
His career experience includes working as an attorney, as a felony prosecutor in the Harris County District Attorney's Office, and as chief clerk for the House Higher Education Committee.
He has served as president of the Houston 80-20 Political Action Committee and as a board member for OCA Greater Houston.
Wu assumed office in 2013, and in the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the Appropriations and Juvenile Justice & Family Issues committees.
He defeated Lee Sharp in the November 5, 2024 general election and advanced from the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary; Helen Zhou is the Republican candidate in 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Wu named public safety, public education and public healthcare as the policy areas he is personally passionate about.
